title: Emitted bits equal serialized gate clauses
statement: For every gate kind $k$, arity index $c\in\{0,1,2\}$, and three-component natural-number vector $v$, the bits emitted by the program for $(k,c)$ under $v$ equal the serialization of the Tseitin CNF for the gate with output variable $v(0)$ and argument list determined by $c$ from $v(1)$ and $v(2)$.
